sentences.text: 7. Petitioner and complainant/respondent no. 2 are present before the Court and have been duly identified by the Investigating Officer, SI Naresh Kumar, PS. Dabri.

She further states that all the terms of the settlement have been complied with.

I am the R-2 in the present matter.

I have signed the settlement deed with my wish and will.
